ValidationRule.description: Validates that employee contributions for 401(k) and 403(b) plans do not exceed the annual IRS limit of $23,000 (or $30,500 with catch-up)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(TEXT(Plan_Type__c) = "401(k)", TEXT(Plan_Type__c) = "403(b)"), OR( AND(Catch_Up_Eligible__c = false, Employee_Contributions_YTD__c > 23000), AND(Catch_Up_Eligible__c = true, Employee_Contributions_YTD__c > 30500) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Employee contribution exceeds annual IRS limit. For 2024: $23,000 (standard) or $30,500 (with catch-up for age 50+)
